text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Good morrrning.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Scarlet!! Hey, hey, did you hear 
about Vodka!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's with you all of a sudden? 
What about Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Um—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! What is this about?! 
You're... moving out of the dorms—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. So anyway, I'm heading overseas.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? Overseas!? Out of nowhere!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Like a warrior's training journey, 
y'know? Heheh, sounds pretty cool, right!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—...So, Trainer, what do you think?! Isn't 
she being way too selfish?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, "overseas"?! Deciding 
that without even talking to me! I *am* 
your roommate, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"How am I supposed to calm down?! Geez! 
Idiot idiot idiot, you big IDIOT!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Daiwa Scarlet collapsed onto the sofa 
in the room.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Knock knock! Pardon me~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, Scarleeet! Help Vodka move her 
stuff~!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Since it was decided so suddenly, they're 
seriously understaffed, and the Prez is in 
a real pinch, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, come on, don't be selfish~. I'm 
telling you, I need every pair of hands I 
can get!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? No no no! That's my room too, you 
know!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally down♪ Alrighty, I'll do my 
best to help out the Prez♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why are you moving ahead without 
me!? H-Hold on a second!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Phew! That wraps up this part!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, then I'll go take care of the 
paperwork. I'll leave the rest to you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Booo! Vodka, you never change."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Can't be helped! I'm gonna go ask the 
President to praise me instead!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Look who's talking. ...Anyway, see ya 
later, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: She really left.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm not lonely in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I just went back to the room as it was 
before she arrived, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
On my first day after enrolling, I 
finished registration... and was shown to 
this room.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
As I unpacked in the empty room, I thought 
about who my roommate might be.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Because if it were an upperclassman, 
you'd be nervous every day, wouldn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And then that guy came over. ...What do 
you think he did out of nowhere?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"All she said was 'Nice to meet you,' and 
then she suddenly started putting up bike 
posters!?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Normally, wouldn't there be more 
conversation than this?! I mean, we're 
about to live in the same room, aren't 
we?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, she's always only 
ever done whatever she wanted to do."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The Derby, going overseas... It's truly 
completely reckless.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...And yet, why?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why do I find myself thinking she can 
actually pull it off?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why do I find myself expecting her to run 
all the way down her own path?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why am I imagining her crossing the line 
in first place...?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not just me. Everyone feels the 
same way.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Even during the Queen Elizabeth II Cup! 
All anyone could think about was "Vodka"!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...She's seriously in the way, and so 
unfair.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Even though I want to be number one too...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want people to say, 'When you think of 
Uma Musume, you think of Daiwa Scarlet'……!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet's burning desire to be 
"Number One" overflows from within her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The Umamusume who wants to be "Number 
One": Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, I felt like I finally caught 
a glimpse of her true goal—
